meta.fitted_on: train split 0 only: 431 markets (5m 248, 15m 146, 4h 37), opens 2026-08-21..22 UTC; Binance < 2026-08-23

settlement.note: price_to_beat (Chainlink) = K_binance * exp(open_basis); sim settles Up iff TWAP60_binance(end) * exp(eps) >= K_binance, eps ~ N(0, sigma_basis^2) (0 in the base sim)

5m.note: target = s_fast*logit(p) + (s_slow-s_fast)*EWMA_hl(logit p) + b(tau) + u, u AR(1) (half-life halflife_u_s, innovation sd sigma_u); the book re-aligns to the target only at update events (prob update_prob[tau_b] per second) and holds otherwise

15m.note: target = s_fast*logit(p) + (s_slow-s_fast)*EWMA_hl(logit p) + b(tau) + u, u AR(1) (half-life halflife_u_s, innovation sd sigma_u); the book re-aligns to the target only at update events (prob update_prob[tau_b] per second) and holds otherwise

4h.note: target = s_fast*logit(p) + (s_slow-s_fast)*EWMA_hl(logit p) + b(tau) + u, u AR(1) (half-life halflife_u_s, innovation sd sigma_u); the book re-aligns to the target only at update events (prob update_prob[tau_b] per second) and holds otherwise

regime.note: per second: keep current state w.p. p_keep[state], else redraw from pi'(s) ~ table(s) * (1 - p_keep[s]) (so the marginal matches the table); one-sided removes the side beyond the extreme (ask if p_model > 0.5)

size.note: log size ~ N(mu[level], sd[level]); redrawn at update events as AR(1) with rho = (acf1 - (1 - pi_update)) / pi_update so the per-second autocorrelation matches

book_change_profile.note: P(book_age == 0) per (len, tau_b) in train ticks

glm.note: lambda_t = A_m * exp(tau_cell[len,tau_b] + b_absgap*min(|p-mid|,0.3) + b_absz5*min(|z5|,6) + b_onesided*O) * (1 + E_t)^gamma, E_t = decay*E_{t-1} + n_{t-1}, decay = exp(-1/tau_excite); covariates at match time (block time - 3 s); lambda = 0 in the hollow state (fit excludes hollow seconds)

market_effect.note: log A_m = a_len + a_coin + N(0, sd^2)

direction.note: P(taker buys Up | p_model - mid at match time); with prob rho_copy a trade repeats the previous trade's direction in that market

sweep.note: taker limit allows j extra levels beyond the best (j ~ p_extra_levels); size is capped at the displayed depth within the limit; each level touched yields a geometric number of maker legs

tokens.note: probability that a leg is on the Up token, by aggressor direction (Up frame); Down legs carry price 1-p and the opposite side

stamp_delay.note: block time - match time (COVERAGE.md: alignment with the book peaks at 3-4 s)

randomization.note: per market (episode), applied only with --randomize; uniform unless 'log' (log-uniform)

sigma_basis_mult.doc: base sim uses 0 (pure Binance settlement proxy)
